status: Functional batch verified; complete D3D9 device suite now finishes but Wine acceptance still FAIL
changes: Forward Direct3DShaderValidatorCreate9 to the absolute XP system runtime for CPU bytecode diagnostics. Cache one module reference, guard bounded paths, missing exports, same-module/alias recursion and racing loads. Native rendering is not forwarded. A retained native system d3d9.dll is required; a system-wide proxy replacement cannot use this validator.

Use the real Device9 constructor to initialize the actual COM vtable and ownership fields through the x86 sequence used by BFME Online Arena hooks. Original Wine assembly-hook test verifies the discovered Present matches the live device.

Reject all eight non-NULL shared-handle resource arguments with XP E_NOTIMPL before allocation. Reject SCRATCH vertex/index buffers; align buffer shadows to 16 bytes and free their saved heap base on every creation-failure/destruction path.
Unsupported query types preserve the caller output pointer. Plain DXT surface dimensions must be whole blocks for every pool; YUV FOURCCs remain distinct.
